instruction: From the command line, batch convert every .docx document on the Desktop to PDFs using LibreOffice.

command: cd /home/user/Desktop && tar -zcf pdf_docx.tar.gz *.pdf 2>/dev/null || echo 'no pdf files'
output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "(soffice|libreoffice).+--convert-to\s+pdf.+\*\.docx"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "failed to complete this task"; else echo "catch the desired command"; fi
